Copy and paste between your devices, right in the browser.

Pastty is a free online clipboard. Pair your phone, tablet and computers with a short code, then send text, links, photos and videos between them in real time. Nothing to install, no account to create, and nothing kept on a server.

  • FreeNo plans, no sign-up
  • Up to 5 devicesIn one room, on any network
  • Text, images, video10 KB · 5 MB · 50 MB
  • Any browseriPhone, Android, Windows, Mac, Linux

Quick answers

Do both devices need to be on the same Wi-Fi?

No. The code connects them, so a phone on mobile data and a laptop on any Wi-Fi can share a room.

Is what I send stored anywhere?

No. It is relayed to the devices in your room at that moment and never saved on the server.

Does Pastty read my clipboard?

No. You paste what you want to share and press Send.

Is it encrypted?

Yes, in transit: everything travels over HTTPS and secure WebSockets. It is not end-to-end encrypted.

Your shared text, images and videos will land here.

Two devices. One little room.

  1. Create a room. Your first device gets a short code and a QR.
  2. Make the connection. Open this same address on your other device and scan or enter the code.
  3. Send it across. Share text, images up to 5 MB, or videos up to 50 MB with up to five devices.

Rooms last five minutes; joining or reconnecting renews the timer. Content is relayed over your connection; it isn’t saved as message history. Anyone with your code can join, so share it with people you trust.
